keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Your keywords (or seed keywords in Ideas mode), one per line. No limit: duplicates are removed and lists run in batches of 1,000. Symbols and emojis Google Ads does not accept are removed automatically.

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: Metrics: one row per keyword you give. Ideas: your keywords become seeds and are expanded into related keyword ideas, each with full metrics.

maxIdeas.title: Maximum ideas (Ideas mode)
maxIdeas.description: Cap on the number of idea rows returned, so a seed never surprises you with a huge bill. The best ideas come first (highest volume, or most relevant).

geo.title: Location
geo.description: Country code (us, de, in), country name (germany) or a Google Ads location ID (2840, or a city/region ID such as 1023191). Leave empty for worldwide.

language.title: Language
language.description: Language code (en, es, de, zh-cn), name (spanish) or Google Ads language ID (1000). Leave empty for all languages.

network.title: Network
network.description: Google Search only, or Google Search plus search partner sites.

includeTrend.title: Include monthly trend
includeTrend.description: Add monthly_searches (volume month by month) and a trend summary (rising / falling / stable, change %, peak month).

trendMonths.title: Trend length
trendMonths.description: How many months of history in monthly_searches. Up to 4 years.

aiVolume.title: AI search volume (add-on)
aiVolume.description: Also return ai_search_volume — how often the keyword is used inside AI assistants — and ai_monthly_searches. Charged only for keywords that come back with an AI number. Needs a country and language (worldwide runs use United States / English).

minSearchVolume.title: Minimum search volume (Ideas mode)
minSearchVolume.description: Ideas mode: skip ideas below this monthly volume (free). 0 = keep all.

negativeKeywords.title: Exclude ideas containing (Ideas mode)
negativeKeywords.description: Ideas mode: drop ideas that contain any of these words or phrases (e.g. free, jobs).

sortBy.title: Sort ideas by (Ideas mode)
sortBy.description: Which ideas come first (and are kept when the cap applies).

includeAdultKeywords.title: Include adult keywords (Ideas mode)
includeAdultKeywords.description: Ideas mode: allow adult keyword ideas.
